scope: Single isolated headless Chromium on this Windows workstation. Includes owned browser/renderer/GPU/utility processes; excludes Node runner, local HTTP server and sampler. Working-set sums may count shared pages more than once. Private-byte sums measure private allocations, not just resident RAM. Sample maxima may miss transient spikes; lifetime working-set peaks are per-process, not concurrent group peaks. No physical-phone or remote-rollback claim.
query_completion: Complete result count (and query summary for viewport rendering), then pending tbody.inert cleared before starting the next query.
renderer: Viewport rows; complete engine result retained, at most 44 mounted players at 1280x800.
target_scope: Diagnostic instrumented Rust/worker plus extra response observer. Full75/eight/two/20/restart workload and original flags/sampler/network observer, no forced GC. Partial Rust requested-capacity inventory, not complete/additive OS memory or acceptance.

storage.scope: Partial Rust storage inventory. Vec capacities and row sizes; HashMap capacity times slot size is an estimate excluding extra buckets/control bytes. Excludes Strings, other nested heaps, allocator metadata/free space, JS/native buffers and compiled code. Categories must not be used as a complete/additive OS-memory partition.
